title: Focus indicator not visible
user_impact: Keyboard users cannot see which element is focused.
source: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.7 Focus Visible (and SC 2.1.1 for the plain-element controls the note points at)
applicability: Pages whose accessibility tree has more than five nodes and no focusable or interactive node besides the document root.
expectation:
One needs_review per page (at "root") when the page has content (more than
five AX nodes) but no focusable or interactive element: 2.4.7 has nothing to
apply to, yet a page without any control is unusual enough that a human
should check whether operable content was built from plain elements. A page
with focusable elements gets no note from this rule. Never pass or
violation.
manual_reason: The accessibility tree carries no focus-indicator data; 2.4.7 itself is decided by focus/outline-removed. This rule can only point a human at a page that exposes no focusable element at all, where controls may be built from plain elements.
